phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capsule filling machines are automated pharmaceutical equipment designed to accurately fill empty capsules with powders, granules, or pellets. The most common industry-standard form is a semi-automatic or automatic powder-fill capsule filling machine with rotary or tamping pin mechanisms.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: These machines dominate pharmaceutical manufacturing due to their efficiency, reliability, and ability to handle high throughput with consistent dosing. Most capsule filling operations employ rotary or tamping pin technology as it enables precise, high-speed filling widely adopted worldwide.
